newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh officials told to hang up or pay up.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh officials told to hang up or pay up.

text.p: Bangladesh government officials have been told to cut down on telephone calls, the Morning Sun newspaper reported on Monday.
The directive was aimed at "limiting abuse" of telephones by government officials in the office and at home where call charges at present are reimbursed, the newspaper said.
A circular cautioned that the government would no longer reimburse charges for more than 800 local calls from homes of top bureaucrats a month.
Their deputies would be allowed to make 650 calls a month and juniors 450, the newspaper said.
